/-- Internal representation of a linear combination of atoms, and a constant term. -/
structure LinearCombo where
  /-- Constant term. -/
  const : Int := 0
  /-- Coefficients of the atoms. -/
  coeffs : Coeffs := []
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
